What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Accelerator Cable for the Suzuki Samurai.
Fits the American LHD (Left Hand Drive) Model.
SIZE: Sheathing: 30″ (From Clip-in Grommet to Bend in Metal Tube)

Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
